method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

evidence.quote: Search library catalogs and repositories directly from Zotero

checkNote: Static analysis found no key, token or password handling, and I grepped librarysearch.js for api key, wskey, token and password with no hits. The README says it is "self-contained", and "Trove was removed: it no longer offers open SRU and now requires a personal API key." The plugin therefore deliberately keeps to keyless public SRU/OAI endpoints, and nothing in it asks the user for a key. It has no AI features.
